title: Line Reflection
description:
Given n points on a 2D plane, find if there is such a line parallel to the y-axis that reflects the given points symmetrically.
In other words, answer whether or not if there exists a line that after reflecting all points over the given line, the original points' set is the same as the reflected ones.
Note that there can be repeated points.
 
Example 1:


Input: points = [[1,1],[-1,1]]
Output: true
Explanation: We can choose the line x = 0.

Example 2:


Input: points = [[1,1],[-1,-1]]
Output: false
Explanation: We can't choose a line.

 
Constraints:

n == points.length
1 <= n <= 104
-108 <= points[i][j] <= 108

 
Follow up: Could you do better than O(n2)?

def check(candidate):
    assert candidate(points=[[1, 1], [-1, 1]]) == True
    assert candidate(points=[[1, 1], [-1, -1]]) == False
    assert candidate(points=[[0, 0], [0, 1], [0, 2]]) == True
    assert candidate(points=[[1, 0], [2, 0], [3, 0], [4, 0]]) == True
    assert candidate(points=[[1, 2], [2, 2], [3, 2]]) == True
    assert candidate(points=[[1, 2], [2, 2], [4, 2]]) == False
    assert candidate(points=[[1, 1], [1, 1], [-1, 1], [-1, 1]]) == True

    assert candidate(points=[[-3, 1], [-1, 1], [1, 1], [3, 1]]) == True
    assert candidate(points=[[-1, 0], [1, 0], [2, 0]]) == False
